guideText:
How to receive email

Mail reaches HappyToHelp through the receiving domain’s MX records. Use a subdomain such as in.yourcompany.com so your main mail is untouched. Pick one way:

Cloudflare Email Routing (the domain’s DNS is on Cloudflare)

In Cloudflare, open the domain, then Email, Email Routing, and turn it on for localhost.test. Cloudflare adds the MX records.
Under Routing rules, add the custom address local-support (or a catch-all) with the action Send to a Worker, and choose your HappyToHelp Worker.
Save the receiving address above and send it a test email.

SendGrid Inbound Parse (any DNS provider)

At your DNS provider, add an MX record: name localhost.test, value mx.sendgrid.net, priority 10.
In SendGrid, open Settings, Inbound Parse, and configure authenticated forwarding to this installation. The receiving setup guide has the endpoint and private-credential steps.

More detail, including your own gateway: Receive email.
